A food item which restores {{Energy|+|16}} when consumed and will apply the hard worker buff for a duration of 2 minutes. Since the items which can be used to craft a {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==
On use, Cheese patty will apply the hard worker buff for a duration of 2 minutes reducing the amount of energy spent mining and woodcutting by 49%. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
